messages:
Samir Patel: Draft release notes for v0.9.1 attached — need internal announce copy + canary timing. Ping @elaine @helen for copy + @ryan for pinning plan. Deploy window Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. Thoughts?

Elaine Chen: Looking now, will shorten copy to 2 bullets for internal blast. Do we want to mention rollback instructions? :thinking_face:

Mohit Rao: Yes include rollback steps and hotspot metrics to watch (p50/p95 latency, error-rate). Adding the canary playbook link: https://short.link/canary-playbook

Samir Patel: Working on the internal blurb. Draft:
```
Heads up: We’ll deploy v0.9.1 on Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. Key fixes: model pinning to reduce tail latency, batching improvements, and fix for embedding truncation. Canary at 10% QPS starting t+10m. If error-rate > 2% rollback immediately.
```
Thoughts?

Helen J: Make the first sentence softer: "We’ll deploy" is good. Add oncall contact @ryan and note fallback model: redwood/llama-13b-v1 as the safe fallback.

Ryan K: I can take oncall that window. For pinning we'll do 90/10 traffic split and automatic fallback to v1 if latency regresses >20%. Posting the pinning command in a sec.

deploy-bot: canary scheduled: release=v0.9.1 canary=10% start=2025-11-19T16:10:00Z window=2h owner=Samir

Ryan K: Pinning command: `redwoodctl rollout set --model redwood/llama-13b-v2 --traffic 90 --fallback redwood/llama-13b-v1 --timeout 10m`

Elaine Chen: Final internal blurb ready. Short version to paste into internal-announcements:
`We’ll deploy v0.9.1 Wed 09:00-11:00 PT. 10% canary, fallback to v1. Oncall: @ryan. Key fixes: model pinning, batching, embedding truncation fix.`

Samir Patel: Thanks. Can someone sanity-check the release notes link and the ops changelog section I added? https://repo.redwood/devops/changelogs/0.9.1

Mohit Rao: LGTM, small nit: change "embeddings cropping" to "embedding truncation" which is more precise.

Helen J: Done. Also adding a line: "No customer-facing schema changes."

Samir Patel: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the internal announcement at 08:50 PT on Wed, 10 minutes before the window. Who wants to be pinned for escalation?

Ryan K: I'll handle escalation. If rollback occurs I'll run `redwoodctl rollback release v0.9.1` and then open a short postmortem.

deploy-bot: deploy reminder: release=v0.9.1 scheduled in 24h. Runbook: https://short.link/runbook-v0.9.1

Samir Patel: Thanks team — locking the copy now. If no objections by EOD, we post. :white_check_mark:
